mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (as measured by FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over the past month (as measured by UNRATE) signals emerging labor market weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.5pp in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) indicate a policy dilemma where inflation is unaddressed, eroding real returns and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong retail sales growth (RSAFS) indicates sustained consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO increases over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units in the past month signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals reduced manufacturing output that increases inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances during supply shocks when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
